conversation.text:
Police: It’s not your fault, and it’s not Minghao’s fault either.
Police: By the way, Ms. Shen Huijing, I almost forgot to tell you.
Police: Today is your birthday, right? Happy birthday.
Police: I know it may be a bit inappropriate to say this now, but I still think I should tell you.
Police: I went to the stationery store where Minghao often buys candy for Xiyuan. I looked around casually and happened to notice this item.
Police: That day, besides buying candy, he also bought this birthday card. The stationery store owner said Minghao took a long time choosing it.
Police: At the time, I was wondering, there were so many cards there—why did he choose this one in particular?
Police: Seeing you today, I finally understand why.
Respondent: ...Thank you.
Respondent: I always thought... Minghao hated me.
Respondent: I thought he misunderstood me... I never intended to replace his mother’s position...
Respondent: How could I be so foolish...
Respondent: Knowing full well that he had suffered so much...
Respondent: Officer Quan,
Respondent: How is Xiyuan’s mother now?
